answer: The sable counter is kept in plume and ferrous reveals each reset. An adversary as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 13 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 13 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Scaling to 809 identities multiplies that fee by 714 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
